title: Modifications — Catalog
description: Index of modification files. Modifications change WHAT the student learns, how content is delivered, or how the student is assessed (distinct from accommodations, which change HOW the student accesses the same content). Always start with the primer if unsure of the distinction. Always verify the IEP authorizes the modification — modifications without IEP authorization are out of scope.

files.title: Accommodation vs. Modification — Primer
files.description: Foundational distinction with examples and decision rules. Read this first if uncertain whether a proposed change is accommodation or modification.

files.title: Curriculum / Content Modifications
files.description: Modifications that change WHAT is taught — content scope reduction, off-grade-level work, simplified content, focused grading, etc. Most likely to impact graduation requirements.

files.title: Assignment Modifications
files.description: Modifications to the work the student is asked to do — reduced volume, alternate format, simplified version, alternate question types, word banks, chunked release, flexible deadlines, cloze procedures.

files.title: Assessment Modifications
files.description: Modifications to how the student is assessed — modified rubrics/mastery criteria, alternate assessment methods, alternate state assessment, off-grade-level assessment, untimed/multi-day, open-resource.
